svg.text: ESP32 braking distance & motion logger · VL53L0X · DS3231 · MicroSD · rotary encoder
Pins with the same label (3V3, 5V, ground) are connected.
VL53L0X and DS3231 share the I²C bus on GPIO21/22;
most breakouts already carry the pull-up resistors.
Encoder A uses the ESP32 internal pull-up (INPUT_PULLUP).
Encoder B goes to GPIO26 but the firmware does not read it.
SD VCC → 5V assumes a module with an onboard 3.3 V
regulator; a bare 3.3 V module goes to 3V3 instead.
ESP32 GPIOs are not 5 V tolerant — keep all signal
